# Build product-type -> items mapping from existing cart and prod_info data
cart_items = cart['cart_items']
# prod_info contains product_type and price for each product_id in cart
prod_info_by_id = {p['product_id']: p for p in prod_info}

items_by_type = {}
for ci in cart_items:
    pid = ci['product_id']
    ptype = prod_info_by_id[pid]['product_type']
    items_by_type.setdefault(ptype, []).append({
        'product_id': pid,
        'product_type': ptype,
        'quantity': ci['quantity'],
        'unit_price': ci['price'],
        'name': ci['product_name']
    })

for ptype, items in items_by_type.items():
    prices = sorted([(it['product_id'], it['unit_price']) for it in items], key=lambda x: x[1])
    min_price = prices[0][1]
    cheapest_ids = [pid for pid, pr in prices if pr == min_price]
    to_buy = cheapest_ids
    to_move = [it['product_id'] for it in items if it['product_id'] not in to_buy]
    print('TYPE', ptype)
    print('  items:', [(it['product_id'], it['unit_price'], it['quantity']) for it in items])
    print('  cheapest_price:', min_price)
    print('  buy_ids:', to_buy)
    print('  move_ids:', to_move)
